description: Machine-readable inventory of every browser-storage key and outbound processor used by victorndunda.com (public site + browser-local demo tools). The privacy policy is generated from this file's content. scripts/test_data_inventory.js fails CI when a new key or endpoint appears without an entry here.

modes.demo: Default. All private tooling is browser-local; no server-side identity, storage, or verified payments exist.
modes.production: Not deployed. Requires VN_TRUST_CONFIG (see trust-mode.js + .env.example); fails closed when incomplete.

storageKeys.purpose: Dark/light theme preference.
storageKeys.deletion: Clear site data, or toggle theme and clear.

storageKeys.purpose: Chosen UI language (EN/FR/SW) for i18n.
Owner dashboard sign-in marker (email, name, avatar URL, activity time). 30-minute idle timeout.
storageKeys.retention: Current tab session; removed on logout/timeout.
storageKeys.deletion: Logout, timeout, or closing the tab.

storageKeys.purpose: Owner dashboard activity feed (last 50 events).
storageKeys.retention: Until cleared via Settings → Clear activity log.
storageKeys.deletion: Dashboard Settings → Danger Zone → Clear activity log.

storageKeys.purpose: Owner dashboard login attempts (last 20).
Marks TOTP second-factor enrollment per allowlisted email (client-side demo gate).
Scope-wizard briefs (package, estimate, contact details). Also the pre-portal legacy store migrated into the encrypted vault.
storageKeys.pii: name, email, company, phone, project description
storageKeys.retention: Until the brief is deleted or migrated into the encrypted portal vault.
storageKeys.encryption: none in this key (plaintext); migrated copies are AES-GCM encrypted inside vn_portal_auth
storageKeys.deletion: Wizard UI or clearing site data.

storageKeys.purpose: Client workspace account record: email, PBKDF2 salts + verifier, and the AES-GCM encrypted vault blob.
storageKeys.pii: email; all project/payment/message data inside the encrypted vault
storageKeys.encryption: vault AES-GCM-256 (key derived from password, held in memory only); salts/verifier are PBKDF2-SHA256 210k iterations

storageKeys.purpose: Keyless tab-session marker (email + activity time) for the client workspace. v3: NEVER contains the vault key.
storageKeys.deletion: Logout, lock, or closing the tab.

storageKeys.purpose: Remember-me record for the client workspace: email + expiry ONLY (v3). Never a key.
Client workspace event log (last 100) mirrored for the owner dashboard on shared devices.
Owner dashboard: client snapshots imported from VN2/VN1 codes — always marked unverified/client-reported; includes payment ledgers.
storageKeys.pii: client name, email, company, payment refs
storageKeys.deletion: Clear site data (no per-record UI yet).

storageKeys.purpose: Owner dashboard: nonces of imported snapshot codes for replay detection (last 200).
Email of the seeded demo workspace on this device (demo accounts never email the owner).
Invoice tool: invoice records with line items and owner-recorded payment events.
storageKeys.retention: Until deleted in the invoice tool.
storageKeys.deletion: Invoice tool delete button / JSON export.

storageKeys.purpose: Owner dashboard outreach tracker (last 50).
Custom projects added from GitHub via the owner dashboard.
Owner job-application pipeline.
Resume download counter (this browser).
Visit counter (this browser).
Local record of newsletter signups captured on this browser.
Command palette recent-pages memory (last 8).
Command palette search index cache (12h TTL).
Proposal tool: saved proposals (client, scope, pricing) — owner device, same model as invoices.
storageKeys.retention: Until deleted in the proposal tool.
storageKeys.deletion: Proposal tool delete / clear site data.

storageKeys.purpose: ROI calculator: the visitor's saved inputs so returning visitors see their last scenario.
Per-article read marker (dynamic key prefix vn_read:).
Booking assistant: last estimate configuration for hand-off context.
Assessment flow context.
Booking assistant rate-limit markers (one ping per event type per 4 minutes).
GitHub API response cache for repo cards (dynamic prefix gh_).
GitHub API rate-limit backoff marker.
Transient storage-availability probe written and removed immediately by portal-core.

outboundProcessors.name: Web3Forms
outboundProcessors.purpose: Contact/booking/portal notification email relay to the site owner. Demo portal workspaces (demo-*) never send.
outboundProcessors.data: Form fields the visitor types; booking estimates carry configuration only (no chat text).

outboundProcessors.name: Google Identity Services
outboundProcessors.purpose: Owner dashboard Google sign-in (ID token, signature verified against JWKS).
outboundProcessors.data: Email, name, profile picture of the signing-in user.

outboundProcessors.name: Google JWKS endpoint
outboundProcessors.purpose: Public signing keys to verify Google ID token signatures (read-only).
outboundProcessors.data: None (public keys fetched; no user data sent).

outboundProcessors.name: Google Fonts
outboundProcessors.data: Font requests (IP visible to Google as with any CDN).

outboundProcessors.name: GitHub API
outboundProcessors.purpose: Repo metadata for project cards and the owner's add-from-GitHub tool. Sequential, cached (gh_*), with backoff.

outboundProcessors.name: Arbeitnow API
outboundProcessors.purpose: Job listings for the jobs tool.

outboundProcessors.name: RemoteOK API
outboundProcessors.purpose: Job listings for the jobs tool.

outboundProcessors.name: cdnjs (jsPDF)
outboundProcessors.purpose: PDF export library on the contract page.

outboundProcessors.name: GitHub Pages
outboundProcessors.purpose: Static hosting. Receives standard HTTP logs only; no site-side analytics or tracking cookies.
outboundProcessors.data: HTTP request logs (IP, user agent) held by GitHub.

outboundProcessors.name: WhatsApp / X deep links
outboundProcessors.purpose: Navigation-only hand-off links the visitor explicitly clicks.
outboundProcessors.data: Pre-filled message text chosen by the visitor.

invariants: No AES/decryption key is ever written to localStorage or sessionStorage (vn_portal_session and vn_portal_remember are keyless by design; enforced by test_trust_boundaries.js).
Snapshot imports are always stored unverified with payments downgraded to 'reported'.
Demo workspaces (email prefix demo-) never trigger owner notifications.
Adding a storage key or outbound endpoint without registering it here fails CI (test_data_inventory.js).
